Packages.//: Pre-lockdown: a changed package at an already-installed version (e.g. Tooltip V1 tweaked again)
Packages.//lockdown: OVERWRITES it instead of being refused, so iteration never forces V2..V64. Set false to lock down.

Media.//: MAI-§4.11. Backing store for /_media/{uid}. 'local' keeps assets on disk under {ContentRoot}/media;
Media.//azure: 'azure' streams them to Blob Storage and 302s to a short-lived SAS so Azure serves Range/seek.
Media.//creds: Credentials belong in the Vault 'Media' bucket, not here (HOUSE-LAW-3). azure fails closed without one.

Azure.//ConnectionString: Account connection string; enables key-signed SAS. Or set BlobServiceUri for Entra.
Azure.//PublicRead: true when the container allows anonymous reads: hands out a plain, CDN-cacheable URL instead of a SAS.

Mfa.//: MFA is OFF for now (MAI-§4.3). RequireForAdmin=false stops the forced
Mfa.//enroll: /account/mfa/setup redirect and makes MaPolicies.Admin role-only. Flip to true to re-enable.
